segments.text: Yua is the total package – brains, beauty, and a dazzling personality that makes everyone green with envy. She's the ultimate high-maintenance queen, the kind of girl who's always just out of reach.
She never lets her guard down easily, and her confident, all-knowing gaze can make you feel like she's got you all figured out.
At this point, Yua feels less like a heroine and more like the final boss in a video game.
Still – she's got a mischievous streak and loves to mess with people. Every now and then, she'll let her playful side show... if you're lucky enough to catch it.
Translated from the official website
才色兼備で振る舞いも明るく、誰もが羨む人気者。そして難攻不落の高嶺の花。
簡単に素顔や弱みを見せてはくれない上に、自信たっぷりになにもかも見透かしたような視線を向けてくる。
もはやヒロインというよりは、ラスボスに近しい存在感を放っている。
だけどイタズラや人をからかうことが大好きなので、たまにお茶目な一面も見せてくれることも……あったりなかったりする。

Raised abroad for most of her life, Kirame is a half-Japanese girl who landed in Japan for her studies. Her favorite food? Takoyaki, hands down.

Kirame usually plays the part of the demure damsel, but she's a bundle of sensitivity and expressiveness – often blurting out "Hwa!?" in surprise or bawling "Bueee~" when she's upset. It's such an emotional rollercoaster.

After a tipsy night, she mistakenly believes she had a one-night stand with Nao, who was just trying to be a good Samaritan. Now, she's decided the protagonist needs to step up and take responsibility.
Kirame is pretty shy and struggles to make friends, even though she craves them. Her roommate, Layla, is her only close friend.
Despite her shyness, Kirame has a heart of gold and a knack for understanding others' feelings. But her Achilles' heel? She's a pushover and easily swayed by others.
Translated from the official website
長らく海外育ちで留学にやってきたハーフ娘。タコ焼きが大好物。
普段はお淑やかぶっているが、感受性豊かで、ホワッ！？と驚いたり、ぶえぇえ～と泣いたりして忙しい。
酔った勢いで介抱してくれた主人公とワンナイトな関係を持ってしまったと勘違いし、その責任をとってもらうことにする。
人見知りしがちなので、友達を作るのが苦手。とっても友達を欲しがっている。ルームメイトのレイラは唯一の親友。
人の気持ちをしっかりと考えられる優しさを持っている。一方で、押しに弱く、流されやすいのが玉に瑕。

Rui's a secret geek who keeps her otaku side under wraps. Online though? She's killing it as a cosplayer with quite the following. She's so deep in the otaku rabbit hole that she plays it cool at university to blend in.

These days she's itching for some fellow geek friends. For whatever reason, Rui's got this thing about Yua and happens to be the only one in on the protagonist's dirty little secret - that he's playing both Yua and Kirame.

She comes off as bossy and tough as nails, which makes people think twice before approaching her, but beneath all that attitude, Rui's got a heart of gold. Sure, she'll grumble and roll her eyes, but she'll always have your back when it counts.
Translated from the official website
隠れオタ女子。ＳＮＳ上では結構有名なコスプレイヤー。
かなりディープな厄介オタクなので、大学では猫被っている。オタ友が欲しい今日この頃。
理由は定かではないが結愛に執着し続けていて、唯一主人公が結愛と煌に二股をかけていることを知っている。
高圧的な物言いと、気の強さからお近づきになるのに勇気が要るが、なんだかんだ面倒見がよく、ため息や悪態つきながらも助けてくれるめっちゃいい人。

Umino Miyako has a personality like a street-smart alley cat. Usually, she's as aloof as they come, both in words and deeds. But just when you least expect it, she's cozying up to you—talk about a fickle feline!

Don't let Miyako's cool cucumber act fool you. Behind that calm facade, she's quite the social butterfly, juggling a surprisingly packed calendar and a friend circle that's way more extensive than you'd expect. Talk about still waters running deep!
Miyako is head over heels for the ocean. She's always itching to swing by the beach after class or spend her days off just staring at the waves, lost in thought.

Miyako and our protagonist go way back, and they're thick as thieves. Their closeness often leads people to jump to conclusions, thinking they're an item. But for these two? They don't see each other that way.
Translated from the official website
人慣れした野良猫みたいな性格で、普段は言動も行動も素っ気ないが、ふと気づけばすり寄ってきたりと非常に気まぐれ。
落ち着いている印象を持たれがちだが、友達も意外とたくさんいてそこそこアクティブ。
海がとても好きで、よく大学帰りに寄りたがったり、休みの日にぼんやり眺めてたりする。
主人公とはそれなりに付き合いが長く、距離感も近いので、周りからは付き合っているように見えがちだが、本人たちにその気はない。

Nao's got a quirky personality and marches to the beat of his own drum. Chronic insomnia often leaves him with dark circles under his eyes and a perpetually sleepy look.

Thanks to a misunderstanding with Kirame, he ends up in a situation that looks suspiciously like a one-night stand. To make matters worse, his long-time crush, Yua, suddenly decides to respond to his confession, which he had left hanging for ages. Just like that, he's slapped with the title of a two-timing scoundrel.
Nao tries to roll with the punches, figuring what's done is done, but he has absolutely no idea what to do next.
Translated from the official website
本作主人公。
ひょうきんな性格で、マイペース。慢性的な不眠症でよく目の下にクマを作っていたり、糸目になってたりする。
煌と誤解ではあるものの、ワンナイト紛いなことをしてしまい、さらにはずっと保留にしていた告白の返事を結愛が急に返してきたせいで、いきなり二股クズ野郎の称号を押しつけられることに。
二股しちゃったものはしょうがないと開き直るが、今後のビジョンはまったく持ち合わせていない。
ちなみに『女の子の泣く顔が好き』という、どうしようもなくクズ感の出る特殊性癖の持ち主。
